description: ΣΤΟΙΧΕΙΑ ΘΑΛΑΣΣΙΩΝ ΠΛΩΤΩΝ ΜΟΝΑΔΩΝ ΥΔΑΤΟΚΑΛΛΙΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΓΡΟΤΙΚΩΝ ΥΠΟΘΕΣΕΩΝ. Provision of data for the aquaculture units of the Decentralized Administration of Attica. The following tables are included: • Table 1: Marine floating aquaculture units per Regional Unit • Table 2: Cultivated species of marine floating aquaculture units • Table 3: Marine floating aquaculture units per Aquaculture Development Area (ADA). Coverage: ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΓΡΟΤΙΚΩΝ ΥΠΟΘΕΣΕΩΝ. The portal shows the English title as "DATA OF MARINE FLOATING AQUACULTURE UNITS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΓΡΟΤΙΚΩΝ ΥΠΟΘΕΣΕΩΝ. Its keywords include ΥΔΑΤΟΚΑΛΛΙΕΡΓΕΙΑ, ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ, ΕΚΤΡΕΦΟΜΕΝΑ ΕΙΔΗ, ΘΑΛΑΣΣΙΑ ΕΚΤΑΣΗ. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
